UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile stored under the user's private profile subcollection.

userId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the owner.

name.description: Display name of the user (1 to 100 characters).

email.description: Email address of the user (up to 254 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on profile creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on profile updates.

TaskList.title: TaskList
TaskList.description: A user-owned named task list for organizing tasks.

userId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the list owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set on list creation (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set on creation and update.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: A user-owned to-do task supporting custom lists, subtasks, start date/time, due date/time, deadline, recurrence, starring, drag-and-drop sort order, and Google Calendar linkage.

userId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the task owner.

description.description: Optional task description (0 to 1000 characters). Omitted when null.

dueDate.description: Optional due date as UTC start-of-day epoch milliseconds. Omitted when null.

dueTime.description: Optional due time in 24-hour HH:mm format. Omitted when null.

startDate.description: Optional start date as UTC start-of-day epoch milliseconds. Omitted when null.

startTime.description: Optional start time in 24-hour HH:mm format. Omitted when null.

deadline.description: Optional hard deadline date as UTC start-of-day epoch milliseconds. Omitted when null.

listId.description: Optional custom TaskList document ID. Omitted when unassigned.

isCompleted.description: Whether the task is currently marked completed.

isStarred.description: Whether the task is starred as important.

subtasks.description: Up to 50 subtasks ({id, title, isCompleted}) attached to this task.

calendarEventId.description: Optional Google Calendar event ID when synced to Google Calendar.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and every update.

TaskHistoryEntry.title: TaskHistoryEntry
TaskHistoryEntry.description: Append-only audit log entry recording task lifecycle and Google Workspace sync actions.

userId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the owner.

taskTitle.description: Snapshot of the task title when the event occurred (1 to 120 characters).

details.description: Optional human-readable summary details (up to 300 characters).

timestamp.description: Server timestamp when the event was recorded.

/users/{userId}/profile/{profileId}.description: Private user profile document stored at profileId = 'info'.

/users/{userId}/history/{eventId}.description: User-scoped append-only task activity history log.
